scope: Venezuela medical discovery — Universidad del Zulia Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Universidad del Zulia's official professionalisation portal identifies its Faculty of Medicine and describes the faculty's health-sciences mission. The specific current pathway displayed on the reviewed page is an equivalency route to a nursing degree, not a medicine intake.

holdReasons: No current official source was located that establishes a new-entry Médico Cirujano programme at the Faculty of Medicine.
No current medicine admissions, fees, duration, curriculum, language, clinical sites, recognition, international eligibility, accommodation, funding or support evidence was located.
The reviewed portal's January 2024 equivalency requirements are not evidence of an undergraduate medicine route and must not be repurposed as one.
nextAction: Obtain a current LUZ Faculty of Medicine programme catalogue and admissions notice that directly identifies the Médico Cirujano route before considering a payload.
